title: Shrink
description: This creature's Attacks deal 30% less damage for the next 3 turns.
smart_description: Attacks deal 30% less damage for {Amount} turn(s) while {ApplierName} remains.
notes: Visually scales the affected creature to 50% of its normal size. Decrements by 1 each turn. Removes itself when the applier dies. Allows negative stacking (AllowNegative = true).
